source_document.title: MetaIndux-TS: Frequency-Aware AIGC Foundation Model for Industrial Time Series
source_document.venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, vol. 36, no. 10, October 2025
source_document.table_title: Performance on few-shot learning tasks of different diffusion models

protocol: All normal-condition data plus 10% fatigue-condition data; generated data train a two-layer LSTM evaluated on real fatigue-condition data.
audit_note: The paper defines normal as RUL > 30 and fatigue as RUL < 30 but does not state how equality at RUL=30 is handled.
